Stop scrubbing through hours of streams for one good moment.
GTA Six Clipper helps turn streams into vertical Shorts.
Give it a Twitch, YouTube, or Kick link. It transcribes the stream locally and looks for spikes in chat and loudness.
It uses those signals to suggest moments. An AI pass is optional.
Then it can stack the streamer above the game, add a hook, and create word-by-word captions.
You review each clip, adjust the edit, and keep the original.
The tool is free, though optional AI and publishing services may cost money.
